changelog.summary: Connect a verified feature release and exposure rule to a source-bound adoption observation without assuming usage or impact.

title: Release to Observed Adoption
description: Connect a verified feature release and exposure rule to a source-bound adoption observation without assuming usage or impact.
setup_prompt: Use Release to Observed Adoption as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One product, feature, exact release and flag revision, eligible population, observation window and Product owner.
Re-read deployment and flag records, the approved release gate, versioned product events and identity coverage for eligible accounts.
A go decision is not deployment; deployment is not exposure; exposure is not use. Count only eligible, exposed and observed users under one frozen event rule.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
